outcome.description: done: the work for this hand-off is finished and you already handed the issue back (e.g. PR opened, in_review, assigned to the reviewer). needs_input: a decision or answer is needed. blocked: a tool, permission, environment or dependency stops you. escalate: the issue needs a stronger model to continue.

summary.description: One or two plain-text sentences on what this run did, for the Talos log.

comment.description: HTML for the issue thread. Required for needs_input (the question, options and your recommended option), blocked (what is blocking and what would unblock it) and escalate (why). Empty for done.
